title: Fix Edit/Delete Record dialog so pickup list and form can scroll

requirements.text: Fix the Edit/Delete Record dialog layout so the dialog body scrolls correctly when the list of pickups (or the edit form) exceeds the viewport height, allowing users to access and select records near the end of the day.

quotes: When trying to edit existing record the window that opens does not scroll. If the number of records for the day are more than one screen, I can't access records towards the end of day

acceptanceCriteria: With a day containing enough pickups to exceed one screen height, the pickup list inside the Edit/Delete Record dialog is scrollable and the last pickup can be reached and clicked.
When editing a pickup, if the edit form exceeds the dialog height, the form content is scrollable and the Save/Delete/Cancel controls remain reachable via scrolling.
Scrolling works on both desktop and mobile-sized viewports without the page behind the dialog scrolling instead of the dialog content.
No regression: selecting a pickup still transitions into the edit form without blank screens or runtime errors.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn UI components); fix scrolling by adjusting composition/layout in app components (e.g., frontend/src/components/EditDeleteRecordDialog.tsx).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Changing backend data models or pickup query logic.
Adding new features to the Edit/Delete flow beyond making the existing dialog scroll correctly.
